verdict.rationale: LangChain agents (built on LangGraph) can consume MCP servers via MCPAdapter/langchain-mcp-adapters, which discovers a server's tools and converts them into LangChain tools usable in LangGraph agents. This is documented first-party but there's no independent/hands-on community corroboration of MCP usage specifically. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of MCP server integration, more detail on configuration/auth for multiple MCP servers, and confirmation of production robustness.
